native_MuJoCo_reference.role: one already-exposed native1kg success-route engineering episode

states.MONITOR_PUSH: Original native hard guards first; native success stays on its original path. Reuse continuous60ms legal-contact/motion_ready/<2mm initial-progress monitor, near-goal excluded; Oracle X only, never WM input.
states.SOFT_ABORT_LATCH: Lock failed attempt and original A goal/outcome/history. Retire PUSH forward/arm force authority at this control boundary before another PUSH actor command. Do not clear queues/caches or claim box_settled.
states.UNLOAD_BRAKE: Measured full issued+delayed motor epoch, raw-torque/FF-aware compliant arm PD and bounded native-support QP handoff. No zero-action=PUSH stop assumption. Actual contact pattern, no np.ones(4) false support. Positive4-foot bridge at most120ms; genuine unload/brake deadline1s.
states.SUPPORT_CAPTURE: Actual hand legal contact false, selected and all-candidate hand loads<3N, box speed<.02/angular<.1, base speed<.02/angular<.1/tilt<.1, four normal loads>=12N, actual contact-point slip<.03; continuous.2s. Foot-center rolling velocity is not contact slip.
states.PLAN_STOW: Reuse CollisionGuard.segment for full-arm versus all compiled collision geoms (including A/B/C/platform), and separately prove body/leg retreat corridor under same-boundary actual configuration. Keep35mm body/2mm other margins. Direct stow only with fresh clear sweep; otherwise one measured physical retreat.
states.SHORT_RETREAT: Reuse MeasuredBackoff(.63m standoff,.05m/s requested,max.15m/s measured,.18m travel,8s). Request is intent only, NOT negative PUSH-gait validation. Independently implement native-support wrench/body translation from actual state; actual backoff required.
states.RECAPTURE_REPLAN: Physically brake and recapture after retreat, remeasure/reseed from actual commands and velocity, repeat full fresh swept-path proof. No old READY/path receipt; no unbounded retreat retries.
states.PROTECTED_STOW: Original native reverse route is a geometric candidate only. Explicit .45rad/s,1rad/s2 references with actual nonzero issued derivative, measured q/dq, real FF/delay and unchanged torque/geometry guards. Candidate interior arm target must be validated, not blindly arm_pose=zeros.
states.STOW_VERIFY: Measured arm path complete/pose error<.04rad/arm speed<.12rad/s, supported/unloaded/strict limits. Preserve native1s stable +3s verification semantics under distinct failure-recovery flags, not Finish.success=PUSH success.
states.NAV_HANDOFF_WARMUP: Fresh software NAV goal/reference epoch from actual last issued commands; original actor/leg policy frozen. Source per-skill history initialization declared, but require3 actual consecutive acquired control boundaries. Admitted inward arm safety adapter needed; motor queue and full observer/action streams continue.
states.NATIVE_NAV_MOVE: Run original frozen210D NAV on checked route>=.25m and actual progress>=.1m; original position/yaw/stop gates apply. No pose writes, zero-idle-as-NAV, or world-origin/scene alias shift.
states.ARRIVAL_CAPTURE_STOW: Native arrival brake; new arrival reference epoch from last two actually issued NAV targets and real velocity. Recheck swept arm path and bounded stow from actual arrival pose; do not reuse old PUSH seeds.
states.FINAL_READY_HOLD: Fresh current-goal native arrived gates + actual stowed/support/unloaded/strict limits continuously.5s after arrival stow. Any original hard failure stops; do not certify READY from model score or stale receipt.
states.RECOVERED_NAV_READY: Only recovery success; A native_PUSH_success remains false. Fresh RGBD may follow, but B PUSH is not authorized by this protocol.
states.NATIVE_SUCCESS_SEPARATE: Unmodified successful native PUSH/exit branch; never relabel a failed attempt.
states.FAIL_CENSOR: Original hard stop/unsafe prefix/nonfinite/stale receipt/empty reference intersection/timeout: stop the physical loop and preserve actual outcome/data. No auto retry, no force fold after hard stop.

priority: one native termination/predicate sample per actual50Hz boundary, not twice
live_adapter_requirements: Pre-PUSH startup strictly admitted: current native zero-arm run already has real angle/speed exceedances; no claim that startup is safe
Intercept native PUSH actor before next command after failure latch; do not run Machine.update plus a second stateful termination query
Do not instantiate native FinishController unchanged at failed contact: box_settled-only trigger, no explicit unload gate, assumes planned4-foot support
Full18-axis immutable delayed command prefix must remain viable; prospective effort uses raw PD+velocity target+FF, not clipped torque alone
Source default arm zero lies on joint2 lower/joint3 upper bounds; 10mrad inward candidate needs fresh sweep and registered NAV arm adapter, not changed physical state
Actual all-candidate contact and full-scene swept guards, bounded support/backoff executor, actual arrival-stow epoch and fresh READY required
Native Runtime/observer/200Hz action stream source freeze and same-episode video; preserve native failed PUSH and strict-limit labels separately
Recovery must have a separate session/outcome enum, NOT machine.finish.phase=success; otherwise native Machine would record failed PUSH as successful
Initial-contact60ms/2mm is an inherited exposed engineering candidate, not calibrated MuJoCo or hardware threshold; later stalls require another protocol
No repeated PushSettled/LowPosture calls to manufacture elapsed time; substep raw flags and original predicate snapshots have one sampling owner
No fold/NAV command until current measured startup and immutable queue prefix are inside registered domains; failed design screens end/censor rather than restart PUSH

Native CollisionGuard already enumerates arm-versus-all compiled collision geoms, so reuse it with the research model; it is not a full-body/leg backoff sweep by itself

Add private50Hz recovery measurements and200Hz instantaneous guard coverage/event records; current10Hz private catalog cannot independently replay a60ms failure detector. Do not increase RGBD frequency or leak these fields into WM input

auxiliary_calibration: Only original separately-budgeted source calibration world, never a recovery snapshot or training episode; main world untouched
acceptance: genuine A attempt fails before native hard stop and keeps original goal/outcome

measurement_semantics.all_candidate_hand_force_N: sum of individual contact-force magnitudes over all relevant hand links/candidates; never norm of cancelling resultant
measurement_semantics.normal_foot_forces_N: actual contact-frame normal loads, not planned support mask
measurement_semantics.foot_slip: actual tangential velocity at loaded contact points, not sphere-foot center velocity
measurement_semantics.clock: one monotonic main-world clock, not resettable per-skill episode_length_buf
measurement_semantics.reference_epoch: two actual successive issued MotorCommands and their native timestamps, real q/dq, complete5-command queue/per-axis delays; no zero-velocity seed
private_log_fields: actual selected-body pose/velocity and original goal
legal contact/native flags sampled once per control tick
four measured foot normal loads and actual contact-point slip
current stage/authority/reference epoch and raw MotorCommand gains/FF
actual queue prefix and per-axis lag receipt
